question: Should exec/process/node-host tool results redact secret-shaped output by default before the agent sees it, even though existing workflows may no longer receive byte-exact command output?
rationale: The patch closes a sensitive-output exposure, but default redaction changes the agent-visible contract and the choice between default redaction and a raw-output reveal path is a security/product boundary decision.

options.title: Accept default redaction
options.body: Merge after required checks once maintainers accept redaction as the default agent-visible contract and handle any raw-output reveal path separately.

options.title: Require reveal control first
options.body: Keep this PR open until it includes a documented, tested, auditable way to request raw output when redaction is unacceptable.

options.title: Reject default redaction
options.body: Close or redirect this PR if byte-exact exec/process output must remain the default behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept default redaction
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks once maintainers accept redaction as the default agent-visible contract and handle any raw-output reveal path separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on exec/process/runtime and shared redaction surfaces and was directly asked for the decision in the PR discussion.
